scope: Provisional public-source discovery only; no canonical coding, integration, formal validation, or completeness claim.

pass.search_window_utc: 2026-10-11 03:18:29–03:21:01 UTC (observed run bracket; web tool does not expose per-query access timestamps)
pass.coverage: At least two month-specific English/local-language queries per month where local query was feasible, plus focused follow-ups; public search results and relevant accessible pages reviewed.
limitations: This pass is bounded, and no-hit results do not imply no event occurred.
Search results occasionally surfaced wrong-year or neighboring-country items; these were excluded explicitly.
Search index snippets are flagged as such and are not treated as equivalent to opened articles.
